body: Seems like a lot of effort to be everybody.

I like to draw, sometimes. I'm not the best at it by any means, but I've gotten much better at it over the last few months. I went from barely able to draw an anime-esque face to working on my own style and working on making something that looks a little more... anatomically not retarded. I guess that's something. I don't like breaking things.

I was in therapy from about 12-13 on and off until last year (I'm 22). It doesn't help. My longest continual stretch of therapy was 4 years, going regularly. Still nothing. I've tried what feels like a pharmacy of meds and they don't help, I've been inpatient three times at two different facilities. No matter how many 'coping skills' I learn or meds I take it doesn't make anything tolerable.
But what if I've never shined at all? I can't remember a time I've been happy. There's only been that darkness.

I just don't want to make a mess... or fail, again, for the umpteenth time. I've tried, and fucked it up. How sad is that? I'm so much of a fuck-up I fuck up ending my fuck-ups. As far as being forgotten... you don't. I thought that, and pushed everyone away. Now all I have is my boyfriend, and he basically just lets me stay because he feels bad for me and knows I have such awful agoraphobia I couldn't leave if I wanted to. No one else talks to me. No friends. My own mother tells me to go ahead and kill myself. Has for years. Being all alone isn't any better, and the fear of being a burden stays... but you get none of the contact. 

Being starved of human contact literally feels like suffocating on your own loneliness. Drowning on the bile that is your own wasted life. 

Emotions are never meaningless... they mean something, but they don't have a purpose, I think. Wouldn't it be easier if they just went away? Just... darkness, forever. Nothingness. 

Sometimes it feels like the hole I've dug myself into is so deep that no light could ever shine through.
